annotations.title: Make another cover version of a stills carousel

description: Make one other version of a carousel with a different photo as its first slide, as a draft post titled with the post's title and the cover's code (cv-...). The post as it is stays the control. cover is a media id of a photo in the layout, or a slide number (0 is the first) whose lead photo should lead; leave it out to take the layout's next other lead photo (candidates lists the rest, so call again with each). Nothing else about the layout changes. Three other covers is plenty (3); one call makes each. The versions are separate drafts: schedule them on different accounts or days and compare them by the hook tests' rules (a version needs enough views and a clear margin to win).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
